assigned.title: A real-device certification matrix that says who runs each test and why
assigned.acceptance: Every scenario the Windows product must survive is written down, with an explicit owner: automated, or the commander's machine. MEASURED STARTING POINT: docs/TEST_MATRIX.md has eight rows, every cell an automated tier, and no manual, real-device, HDR, hardware-decode or Windows row at all -- while two other documents already require real hardware, for the compositing experiment and for the flash-and-blip A/V rig. REQUIRED: the matrix covers cold start, restart, crash recovery, movie and episodic playback, seek, pause/resume, source switching, resume position, next episode, subtitles, multiple audio tracks, stereo and multichannel, lip-sync and A/V drift, long sessions, 1080p, 4K, HDR where the display supports it, hardware decoding, fullscreen and window transitions, sleep/wake, network interruption and recovery, backend unavailable, malformed or unavailable source, Live TV channel change, EPG behaviour, memory/CPU/GPU behaviour, clean install, upgrade, and uninstall/reinstall. REQUIRED: each row states its owner and, for a commander-machine row, exactly what to do and what a pass looks like -- a matrix that says 'manual' without a procedure is a wish. REQUIRED: rows that cannot be judged without hardware the commander may not have (an HDR display, a multichannel receiver) say so rather than being marked failed. NO ROW MAY BE MARKED PASSED FROM THIS SESSION; nothing here can observe a Windows machine.
assigned.notes: PROPOSED FOR gpt-architect RULING, round 80. Created unowned as part of the WINDOWS PRODUCT COMPLETION phase board so the proposal is machine-readable rather than prose, and NOT claimed before the verdict.
